L. 47; Amaru. 92; U. 5. 12. --5 A sofa. --6 (In Rhet.) N. of a figure of speech which consists in the use of significant epithets; विशेषणैर्यत्साकूतैरुक्तिः परिकरस्तु सः K. D. 340. --8 Judgment. --9 A helper, colleague, co-worker.

परि-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति or -क्रमति (rarely Ā. ˚ते; p. -क्रामत् or -क्रमत्; pf. -चक्राम, -चक्रमुर्; aor. -अक्रमीत्; inf. -क्रान्तुम्; ind.p. -क्रामम्, or -क्रम्य), to step or walk round or about, circumambulate, roam over, walk through, visit (with acc.), RV. &c. &c.; to go past, escape, AitBr.; to outstrip, overtake, R. : Intens. -चङ्क्रमति, to move or walk about perpetually, BhP.
a: परिक्रम् — {c1c} U. 1 To walk about, walk around; परिक्रम्यावलोक्य च (in dramas). --2 To overtake.

s: parikramaH

puM, (parikramaRam । kramu pAdavikzepe + BAve GaY । “nodAttopadeSasyeti .” 7 । 3 । 34 । iti upaDAyA na vfdDiH .) krIqArTaM padByAM gamanam । tatparyyAyaH । vihAraH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 16 ॥ pradakziRam । yaTA, -- varAha uvAca । “SfRu Badre ! mahApuRyaM pfTivyAM sarvvato diSam । parikramya yaTADvAnaM pramARagaRitaM SuBam ॥ BUmyAH parikrame samyak pramARaM yojanAni ca । zazwikowisahasrARi zAzwikowiSatAni ca ॥ tIrTAnyetAni devASca tArakASca naBastale । gaRitAni samastAni vAyunA jagadAyuzA ॥ brahmaRA lomaSenEva nAradena DruveRa ca । jAmbavatA saputtreRa rAvaRena hanUmatA ॥ etEranekaDA devEH sasAgaravanA mahI । kramitA bAlinA cEva vAhyamaRqalareKayA ॥ antarA BramaRenEva sugrIveRa mahAtmanA । taTA ca pUrvvadevendrEH paYcaBiH pARqunandanEH ॥ yogasidDEstaTA kEScinmArkaRqeyamuKErapi । kramitA na kramizyanti na pUrvve nApare janAH ॥ alpasattvabalopetEH prARiBiScAlpabudDiBiH । manasApi na Sakyante gamanasya ca kA kaTA ॥ saptadvIpe tu tIrTAni BramaRAd yat PalaM Bavet । prApyate ttADikaM tasmAnmaTurAyAH parikrame ॥ maTurAM samanuprApya yastu kuryyAt pradakziRam । pradakziRIkftA tena saptadvIpA vasunDarA ॥ tasmAt sarvvaprayatnena sarvvakAmAnaBIpsuBiH । karttavyA maTurAM prApya narEH samyak pradakziRA ॥” iti varAhapurARam ॥
v: pu॰ pari + krama--BAve GaY na vfdDiH । 1 samantAt BramaRe 2 pradaciRokaraRe 3 krIqArTaM padDyAM gamane ca । tatra payivyAH parikape PalAdikasatra varAhapra॰ “SfRu madre! mahApuRyaM pfTivyAM sarvato diSam । parikramya yaTADvAnaM pramARagaRitaM SuBam । BUmyAH parikrame samyak pramARaM yojanAni ca । zazwikowisahasrARi zazwikowISatAni ca । tIrTAnyeta ni devASca tArakASca naBastale । gaRitAni samastAni vAyunA jagadAyuzA । brahmaRA lomaSenEva nAradena DruveRa ca । jAmbavatA saputreRa rAvaRena hanUmAtA । etEranekaDA devEH sasAgaravanA mahI । kramitA vAlinA cEva bAhyamaRqalareKayA । antare BramaRenEva sugrIveRa mahAtmanA । taTA ca pUrvadevEndrEH paYcaBiH pARqunandanEH । yogasidDEstaTA kEScinmArkaRqeyamuKErapi । kramitA na kramizyanti na pUrve nApare janAH । alpasatbabalopetEH prARiBiScAlpabudDiBiH । mabasApi na Sakyante gamanasya ca kA kaTA । saptadvIpe tu tIrTAni BramaRAdyat PalaM Bavet । prApyate cADikaM tasmAn maTurAyAH parikrame । maTurAM samanu prApya yastu kuryyAt pradakziRam । pradakziRIkftA tena saptadvIpA vasunDarA । tasmAt sarvaprayatnena savEkAmAnaBIpsuBiH । karttavyA maTurAM prApya narEH samyak pradakziRA” । lyuw । parikramaRaM tatrArTe na॰ ।
m: परि-क्रम m. roaming about, circumambulating, walking through, pervading, MBh.; Pur.
transition, RPrāt. (v.l. परा-क्र्˚)
following the course of a river down from its source to its mouth and then on the other bank up to its source again, RTL. 348
succession, series, order, Lāṭy.; Kauś.; Mn. iii, 214 (read आवृत्-परिक्रमम्)
a remedy, medicine, Car.
a: परिक्रमः — 1 Roaming about, moving about; Ki. 10. 2. --2 Roaming, walking or passing over. --3 Circumambulating. --4 Walking for pleasure. --5 Series, order. --6 Succession. --7 Penetrating. --Comp. --सहः a goat.

k.v: अपहारस्त्वपचयः समाहारः समुच्चयः। प्रत्याहार उपादानं विहारस्तु परिक्रमः॥

m: परि-क्रमण n. walking or roaming about, ŚāṅkhBr.

s: parikramasahaH
puM, (parikramaM vihAraM sahate iti । saha + pacAdyac .) CAgalaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: puMstrI parikramaM sahate saha--ac । CAge tri॰ striyAM jAtitvAt NIz ।
m: परि-क्रम—सह m. ‘one who bears running about’, a goat, L.
परि-√ क्रन्द् (only aor. Caus. -अचिक्रदत्), to cry or make a noise round about (acc.), RV.

v: pu॰ pari + krI--ac । 1 vinimaye tulyarUpadAnena krayaRe “kozAn rakzArdDakozeRa marvakozeRa vA pun । Seza prakftirakzArTaM parikraya udAhftaH” kAmanda॰ । niyatakAlaM nftyA 3 svIkaraRe si॰ kO॰ tatrArTe karaRasya vA sampradAnatA Satena SatAya vA parikrItaH । lyuw । parikraya tatrArTe na॰ “parikrayaRe sampradAnamamyatarasyAm” pA॰
m: परि-क्रय m. giving up at the cost of (cf. प्राणपरिक्र्˚)
hire, wages, KātyŚr., Sch.
redemption, buying off, W.
a peace purchased with money, Kām.; Hit.
a: परिक्रयः, --क्रयणं — 1 Wages, hire. --2 Employing on wages. --3 Purchasing or buying off. --4 Barter, exchange. --5 A peace purchased with the payment of money; cf. H. 4. 122.

m: परि-क्रयण n. hiring, engaging, Pāṇ. i, 4, 44.

s: parikriyA

strI, (parikaraRam । pari + kf + Sac । “riN SayagliNkzu .” 7 । 4 । 28 । iti riN .) pariKAjalAdinA vezwanam । tatparyyAyaH । parisarpaH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 20 ॥ (ekAhayAgaviSezaH । yaduktaM ASvalAyanaSrOte । 9 । 5 । 12 । “sadyaskriyA anukriyA parikriyA vA svargakAmaH ॥” “parikriyApyekAhA Bavati ezAmanyatamena svargakAmo yajeta ॥” iti nArAyaRI ॥)
v: strI paritaH kriyA । 1 pariKAdinA vezwane amaraH 2 ekAhayAgaBede “sadyaskriyA anukriyA parikriyA vA svargakAmaH” ASva॰ SrO॰ 9512 parikriyApyekAhA Bavati ezAmanyatamena svargakAmo yajeteti” nArA॰ ।
m: परि-क्रिया f. surrounding, inclosing, intrenching, L.
attending to, care of (comp.; cf. अग्नि-परिक्रिया)
exercise, practice, enjoyment (cf. राज्य-परिक्˚)
(in dram.) illusion to future action (= परिकर), Daśar.
परि-क्रिया See परि-कृ.
a: परिक्रिया — 1 Enclosing with a fence or ditch, intrenching. --2 Encircling or surrounding in general. --3 (In dramaturgy) = परिकर (7) q. v. --4 Attention.

k.v: निर्वेश उपभोगः स्यात्परिसर्पः परिक्रिया। विधुरं तु प्रविश्लेषेऽभिप्रायश्छन्द आशयः॥

m: परि-क्रोश m. ‘crier’, prob. N. of a demon, RV. i, 29, 7.
परि-√ क्रुध् P. -क्रुध्यति, to fly into a rage, become enraged, R.
परि-√ क्रुश् P. -क्रोशति (cf. -चुक्रुशुर् ind.p. -क्रुश्य), to go about crying, to wail, lament, MBh.; R.
परि-क्रुष्ट mfn. lamented
परि-क्रुष्ट n. lamentation has been made by (instr.), R.
परि-√ कुप् P. -कुप्यति, to become greatly moved or excited, to be in a rage, to be very angry, MBh. : Caus. -कोपयति, to excite violently, to make very angry, ib.
परि-कुपित mfn. much excited, very angry, wrathful, ib.

v: pu॰ pari + kvaRa--karttari lya । meGe niru॰ 61
m: परि-क्वणन mfn. (√ क्वण्) loud-sounding, loud, Nir. vi, 1.
a: परिक्वणन — a. Loud. --नः Ved. A cloud.

m: परि-√ क्वथ् P. -क्वथति, to become boiling hot, Bālar. v, 48/49.

परि-√ कॢप् Caus. -कल्पयति (Pass. -कल्प्यते), to fix, settle, determine, destine for (with acc., अर्थम् ifc., loc. or an inf. with pass. sense), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to choose, VarBṛS. lix, 11; to perform, execute, accomplish, contrive, arrange, make, Yājñ.; Ragh.; Kathās.; to distribute, divide (with an adv. in धा), Mn.; Var.; MBh.; to admit or invite to (loc.), MBh.; to suppose, presuppose, Sarvad.
a: परिकॢप् — {c1c} A. 1 To tend to. --2 To give, grant, vouchsafe; U. 5. 27. --3 To think. --Caus. 1 To decide, determine. --2 To fix upon, design, make or turn into; Ku. 1. 2. --3 To prepare, get ready. --4 To ondow with; Ś. 2. 9. --5 To destine for. --6 To perform, effect, accomplish. --7 To contrive, invent, devise. --8 To distribute. --9 To invite.

m: परि-कॢप्त mfn. distributed, scattered, found here and there, MBh.
परि-क्षा f. (√ क्षै) clay, mud, dirt, L.
a: परिक्षा — Clay, mud.

v: na॰ pari + kzE--BAve lyuw । parIkzAyAM “yAni parikzARAnyAsaMste kfzRAH paSavo'Bavan” Eta॰ brA॰ 334
m: परि-क्षाण mfn. charred or burnt to a cinder, AitBr.
परि-क्षालन n. water for washing, KātyŚr.
a: परिक्षालनं — 1 Washing, cleansing. --2 Water for washing.

m: परि-क्षाम mfn. excessively emaciated, dried up, fallen away, Kād.; Rājat.
a: परिक्षाम — a. Emaciated, wasted away, lean.

m: परि-क्षीण mfn. vanished, disappeared, wasted, exhausted, diminished, ruined, lost, destroyed
(in law) insolvent, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
a: परिक्षीण — p. p. 1 Vanished, disappeared. --2 Wasted, decayed. --3 Emaciated, worn away, exhausted; Pt. 2. 70. --4 Impoverished, entirely ruined; Bh. 2. 45. --5 Lost, destroyed. --6 Diminished, decreased; प्राण˚ Pt. 4. 23. --7 (In law) Insolvent.

m: परि-क्षीब or परि-क्षीव, mfn. drunk, quite intoxicated, W.

a: परिक्षीव — a. Quite intoxicated.

m: परि-√ 2. क्षल् P. -क्षालयति, (ind.p. -क्षाल्य), to wash out, rinse, wash off, ŚBr.
परि-√ क्षर् P. -क्षरति (aor. -अक्षार्), to cause to flow round (in a stream), RV.; to bestow by pouring forth in a stream, ib.
परि-क्षत mfn. (√ क्षन्) wounded, hurt, injured, killed, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv.
परि-क्षत-व्रत mfn. one who has broken his vow, Bcar.
परि-क्षति f. wounding, injury, lesson, Śiś.
a: परिक्षतिः — f. Injury, hurt, harm.

m: परि-क्षव m. (√ क्षु) frequent or ill-omened sneezing, AV.

v: pu॰ pari + kzi--BAve ac । nASe manuH 9 59
m: परि-क्षय See परि- √ 4. क्षि.
परि-क्षय m. disappearing, ceasing, dissolution, decay, destruction, loss, ruin, end, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: परिक्षयः — 1 Decay, waste, destruction; परिक्षयोपि अधिकं रमणीयः Mk. 1; किरण˚ Ku. 4. 46 --2 Disappearing, ceasing. --3 Ruin, loss, failure; Ki. 16. 57, Ms. 9. 59.

v: pu॰ paritaH kzipyate vizayavAsanayA jIvAtmA yena pari + kzipa--karaRe GaY । 1 indriye “ekAdaSaparikzepaM manovyAkaraRAtmakam” BA ASva॰ 36 a॰ BAve GaY । 2 paritaScAlane ca ।
m: परि-क्षेप m. throwing about, moving to and fro, Hariv.
surrounding, encircling, being (or that by which anything is) surrounded, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
circumference, extent, Car.
abandoning, leaving, W.
a: परिक्षेपः — 1 Moving about, walking to and fro. --2 Scattering, spreading. --3 Surrounding, encircling, circumfluence. --4 An enclosing belt or boundary, that by which anything is surrounded; R. 12. 66. --5 Abandoning, leaving. --6 An organ of sense.

m: परि-क्षेपक mf(इका)n. hung with (ifc.), Kāraṇḍ. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 146).

v: tri॰ pari + kzipa--tAcCIle GinuR । paritaH kzepaRaSIle striyAM NIp ।
m: परि-क्षेपिन् mfn. who or what scatters or distributes, W. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 142).
परि-√ 4. क्षि P. -क्षिणोति, to destroy, BhP. : Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste away, decay, become exhausted, Hit.
परि-√ 2. क्षि P. -क्षेति, to dwell around (with acc.), AitBr. vi, 32.
परि-क्षि m. v.l. for next, VP.
a: परिक्षि — {c5c} {c9c} P. 1 To decay, wane. --2 To be emaciated or lean. --3 To destroy, put an end to.

m: परि-√ क्षिप् P. -क्षिपति (pf. -चिक्षेप; ind.p. -क्षिप्य), to throw over or beyond, R.; to put or lay or wind round, Suśr.; to throw about, surround, encircle, embrace, ib.; MBh.; R. &c.; to throw or put or fix in (loc.), MBh.; to throw away, squander (as a treasure), Kathās.
a: परिक्षिप् — {c6c} P. 1 To surround; गंगास्रोतःपरिक्षिप्तं Ku. 6. 38. --2 To embrace. --3 To put or lay round. --4 To survey round, measure, range over. --5 To throw over or beyond. --6 To throw or put into. --7 To fetter, chain.

s: parikziptaM
tri, (paritaH kzipyate sma iti । kzip + kta .) pariKAdinA vezwitam । tatparyyAyaH । nivftam 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 88 ॥ sarvvatoBAvena kzepayuktaYca ॥
m: परि-क्षिप्त mfn. thrown, thrown about, scattered, surrounded, overspread, MBh.; R. &c.
left, abandoned, W.
a: परिक्षिप्त — p. p. 1 Scattered, diffused. --2 Encircled, surrounded; वेतसपरिक्षिप्ते मंडपे Ś. 3. --3 Intrenched. --4 Overspread, overlaid. --5 Left, abandoned.

k.v: परिक्षिप्तं तु निवृत्तं मूषितं मुषितार्थकम्. प्रवृद्धप्रसृते न्यस्तनिसृष्टे गुणिताहते॥

s: parikzit

puM, (pari sarvvatoBAvena kzIyate hanyate duritaM yena । pari + kzi + kvip । kaliSAsanakarttftvAdasya taTAtvam । yadvA, parikzIRezu kuruzu kziyati Izwe iti । taTA coktaM mahABArate । 10 । 16 । 2 -- 3 ॥ “virAwasya sutAM pUrvvaM snuzAM gARqIvaDanvanaH । upaplavya gatAM dfzwvA vratavAn brAhmaRo'bravIt ॥ parikzIRezu kuruzu puttrastava Bavizyati । etadasya parikzittvaM garBasTasya Bavizyati ॥”) aBimanyuputtraH । tatparyyAyaH । parIkzit 2 pArikzItaH 3 parikzitaH 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (ayaM punaryuDizWirAdanantaraM kaliyugasyAramBe rAjacakravarttI AsIt । kurukzetrayudDe parikzIRe kurukule aBimanyupatnyA uttarAyA garBAjjAtaH । ayameva garBasTaH krudDASvatTAmaprayuktena brahmAstreRa nihato'pi punarBagavataH kfzRasya praBAvAt jIvitaM labDavAn । ayameva vfzarUpiRaM DarmmaM nigfhRantaM kaliM praSaSAsa । tato gacCati kAle ekadA'sO mfgayAM viharan kzuDAtfwapIqitaH mOnavratAvalambinaH SamIkasya munerASramaM gatvA pratyuttaradAnaparANmuKasya tasya skanDe DanuzkowyA mftaM sarpamAsaYjayAmAsa । anenAparADenemaM rAjanaM SamIkasya puttraH SfNgI nAmA tapasvI itaH saptame'hani takzakadazwo'yaM mfto BavizyatItyaBiSaptavAn । etadAkarRyAyaM gaNgAtIre munipraBftiBirISvaranAmakIrttanAdikamAlocayan prAyopaveSane sTitastakzakadazwo mftaSca । ityetatkaTA mahABArate vistarato drazwavyA ॥ (kuruputtraviSezaH । yaTA, harivaMSe । 32 । 90 । “kurostu puttrAScatvAraH suDanvA suDanustaTA । parikzittu mahAbAhuH pravaraScArimejayaH ॥ avikzit-puttraH । yaTA, mahAmArate । 1 । 94 । 50 । “avikzitaH parikzicca SavalASvaSca bIryyavAn ॥”)
v: pu॰ parikzIRe kzayati vardDate kzi--kvip । 1 aBimanyuputre nfpaBede tannAmaniruktiH BA॰ sI॰ 16 a॰ “virAwasya sunAM pUrvaM snuzAM gARqIvaDanvanaH । upaplavagatAM dfdDA satyavAk brAhmaRo'bravIt । parikzIRezu karuzu putrastava Bavizyati । etadasya parikzittvaM garBasTasya Bavizyati । tasya tadvavacanaM sADoH satyametad Bavizyati । parikzid BayitA hyezAM punarvaMSakaraH sutaH” । kvipi upasargadIrTe parIkzit apyatra । karttari kta parikzito'pyatra pabdara॰ । 2 kuveraputraBede pu॰ harivaM॰ 3 2 a॰ । “dvAvfkzO tava vaMSye'smin dvAveva ca parikzitO” tatrEvADyAye । 3 avicataH putre nfpaBede ca “avikzitaH parikzittu SabalASvaSca vIryyavAn” BA॰ A॰ 94 a॰ ।
m: परि-क्षित् mfn. dwelling or spreading around, surrounding, extending (as Agni, heaven and earth &c.), RV.; AV.; AitBr.
परि-क्षित् m. N. of an ancient king (son of Abhimanyu and father of Janam-ejaya), MBh.; Hariv.
of a son of Kuru and father of another Jan˚, Hariv.
of a son of A-vikṣit and brother of Jan˚, MBh.
of a king of A-yodhyā, ib. (cf. परी-क्षित् under 1. परी, p. 605, col. 1).
a: परिक्षित् — m. 1 N. of a king, son of Abhimanyu and father of Janamejaya. --2 An epithet of Agni.

m: परि-क्षित w.r. for परि-चित, or -क्षित्.
